entities.name: Franc Bogovič
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Franc Bogovič is a Slovenian politician who was first elected as a Member of the European Parliament in 2014 and re-elected in 2019. In addition to his committee assignments, he is part of the European Parliament Intergroup on Climate Change, Biodiversity and Sustainable Development.
